# MD Samiul Alam Sumel — Business Process Automation

> MD Samiul Alam Sumel is a business process automation specialist. Samiul turns manual work (spreadsheets, paper forms, hand calculations) into web systems that teams use every day. Samiul has 12+ years of operations experience at Mongla Port Authority, Bangladesh, and is open to remote work worldwide.

This file summarises facts published on https://sasumel.pages.dev/. Case studies describe real systems; CarView and OT Bill are shown only as synthetic mockups with fictional figures.

## Key facts
- Role: Senior Outdoor Assistant (Revenue Branch), Traffic Department, Mongla Port Authority (since November 2013).
- Focus: business process automation, web systems and internal tools, AI-assisted development.
- Systems in daily use: 3 (port billing, vehicle tracking, overtime billing).
- Live deployments: 8+ public web applications.
